summary: Immutable worker-job revisions bind every admitted lane end to end. Implementation v27 and break-fix v24 require one typed owner/case/control acceptance oracle in the job digest, with closed source and authority joins and retained readiness evidence. Definitions generate from one canonical source, and no released-definition version or pin is retained for history (CD-0242 D14). Local acceptance holds the step without delivery; whole-work delivery keeps complete parent admission and integration evidence. A revision recorded under a superseded contract is not ready. Under CD-0242 D6 each launch carries its own scope and subject bindings, and no attempt count, correction window, convergence basis, or escalation wall exists.
title: Worker jobs bind dispatch and separate local acceptance from delivery
